desc:
Raids: Night Tide is an open world PvE shooter about raiding enemy bases your way. Stealthyness is important. Playing in a Squad is more fun and easier. 

Clear up the small Bases to open the Fortress, in each biome.

• Unlock armored Vehicles and helicopters. 🚗🚁
• Customize your Avatar with uniforms, helmets and a bunch of gear. 🪖👕
• Rank up, prestige for stars, spend them on perks or unlock Gamepasses. ⭐
